messages:
Jordan: FY26 Q1 OKR draft uploaded: https://redwood.docs/okrs/fy26-q1. Can we finalize by EOD Friday so I can take to Exec? Top items: Private GA, Product-led growth metric, cost/perf optimizations. Flag risks now.
Li: Quick read — looks good. Two asks: add rollout guardrails for Private and a clear regression-eval requirement for any model change.
Miguel: Heads-up: Private GA requires infra work (networking + autoscaler). If we prioritize, estimate +2 infra sprints (8 weeks). Otherwise we ship a phased MVP.
Priya: From customer side — 3 pilot accounts expect SAML + on-prem packaging. If we don't prioritize SAML we risk churn. Recommend elevating one customer-driven pilot as a gating criterion.
Ben: Financial note — revenue target assumes ~20% Dedicated adoption in year 1. That feels aggressive without pilot conversion metric. Recommend adding a leading indicator (pilot→pay conversion) and gating major spend until pilot validates.
Tasha: Hiring constraint: infra team has two open reqs. Recruiting ETA ~3 weeks. If we commit to +2 sprints we should consider contractors; headscount approvals take time.
Jordan: Proposal: move "Private GA" to OKR Beta milestone. GA requires: pilot sign-off + clear SLA target. Make cost/perf optimizations Tier-1.
Li: Suggested acceptance criteria block:
```
- Pilot: signed contract or LOI from 1 enterprise
- Performance: p95 < 200ms on benchmark for target 2k qps
- Quality: regression evals pass (delta < 1% on key prompts)
```
Miguel: p95 < 200ms @2k qps is optimistic on current infra. With quantized models + batching can hit that in staging but GA at scale likely needs p95 < 350ms. Suggest phased SLA: canary (p95 < 200ms) -> GA (p95 < 350ms).
Priya: Pilot customers would accept a canary SLA if we provide white-glove engineering support during the pilot window.
Ben: If we relax GA SLA to 350ms we should update revenue/projections accordingly and add a dependency: "convert pilot -> paid within 90 days" as a KPI.
Jordan: Actionable asks: 1) Miguel — confirm infra plan and whether contractors solve timeline, by EOD Wed. 2) Priya — get pilot LOI in writing (ACME/BankPilot) by Thurs. 3) Ben/Tasha — confirm budget & hiring path.
Miguel: I can validate contractor plan by Wed, but internal hire timeline still ~3w. Contractors add cost but shorten wall-clock time.
Li: I'll add the rollout steps to the doc: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback on error budget breach. Also adding regression-eval gating.
Priya: ACME gave verbal OK to pilot; I'll push for LOI today.
Ben: Finance ok to provision contractors if pilot LOI exists. Otherwise prefer to hold until pilot shows traction.
Tasha: I'll prioritize the infra reqs with Recruiting; we can fast-track one candidate if Exec approves.
Jordan: Please react to this thread: :thumbsup: = approve current OKR draft (with notes), :eyes: = need more time. I'll compile reactions and surface to Exec.
Li: :thumbsup:
Miguel: :eyes: Need 1wk to confirm infra details
Priya: :thumbsup: (ACME verbal OK; LOI incoming)
Ben: :thumbsup:
Tasha: :thumbsup:
reminder-bot: reminder set — Exec sync scheduled Fri 10:00am PT if draft signed off by EOD Thu.
Jordan: Noting Miguel's request. I'll route to Exec with a one-week infra caveat and proposed phased SLA. Thanks everyone — marking as pending-exec.
